building.description: Two 1878 tenement buildings joined to create a four-story, four-bay lodging house; 1934 yellow-brick modest Art Deco facade.
building.source: Bowery Historic District National Register report, Section 7 p.62

club.predecessor: Palace Bar / Palace Hotel lodging house
club.original_features_note: Hilly Kristal retained the original bar and many original fixtures when operating the space.
club.preservation_note: National Register documentation states the club interior was largely preserved by the post-closure commercial tenant.
club.source: Bowery Historic District National Register report, Section 8 pp.74-75

poc_room_estimate.source: Secondary published descriptions of the narrow shotgun-style storefront; treat as an estimate until verified by survey, plans or a current capture.

rule: Any dimension below 0.85 confidence remains an estimated POC value and must not be presented as historically exact.
